newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Peugeot halts car plant plans in Brazil - paper.
newsitem.headline: Peugeot halts car plant plans in Brazil - paper.

text.p: French carmaker Peugeot has indefinitely postponed plans to set up a car plant in Brazil, Jornal do Brasil newspaper said on Monday.

Brazil's Industry and Commerce Minister Francisco Dornelles has already informed Peugeot's decision to the state governments of Minas Gerais and Rio de Janeiro, the paper said. The French company was negotiating with the two states to locate the plant.
Peugeot planned to invest $600 million to produce 70,000 cars annually, Jornal do Brasil said.

The newspaper also said Peugeot representatives in Brazil last week asked to cancel a meeting with President Fernando Henrique Cardoso, scheduled for June 16, when they would announce the location of the plant.
Jornal do Brasil said Peugeot has not given a reason for the delay.
